# Product and research roadmap

This is a conditional roadmap, not an approved launch schedule. Durations and budgets depend on role, geography, participants, employer access and legal review. Goals refer to [PRODUCT-MODEL.md](PRODUCT-MODEL.md); gates to [AUTHORITY.md](AUTHORITY.md); experiment IDs to [EXPERIMENTS.md](EXPERIMENTS.md).

| Phase | Goal / experiments | Deliverable and exit evidence | Decision |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P0 meaning and mandate | EA-G01 | Exact Definition Pack, ontology, claim ladder, named role and owner, risk and data-purpose review. | Accept research scope or revise. |
| P1 case science | EA-G02; E01-E02 | Job-task map; candidate case grammars, reviewed first-session creativity problems, technical and cooperation cases; item exposure policy and rubrics. | Permit a small non-hiring pilot. |
| P2 challenge proof | EA-G03; E03 | Accessible three-session journey, consent choices, versioned recording/ASR, human calibration, feedback, rights flow and cold replay. | Permit permissioned challenge expansion. |
| P3 measurement | EA-G04; E04-E05, E07 | Parallel-form, rater, mode, construct, fairness and access evidence; revised score specification. | Continue 3×10, narrow construct, add cases or stop. |
| P4 outcome validation | EA-G05; E06 | Preregistered multi-cohort comparison, employer/time holdouts, independent outcome labels and selection-utility estimates. | Accept, reject or narrow the strong thesis. |
| P5 product value and use | EA-G06; E08 | Candidate/employer value and cost evidence, owner-reviewed claim text and deployment controls. | Decide challenge-only, decision aid, hiring use in a named context, or no product. |

Critical path: role/outcome definition -> job analysis -> case/rubric freeze -> permissioned collection -> score reliability and access -> prospective outcomes -> claim decision. Case generation, UI and scoring service can be built in parallel only after their interface definitions are frozen. An employer pilot before P4 can collect outcomes, but its scores remain research-only unless a separate existing-law and validation basis is documented.

## Explicit branch decisions

- If Session 1 shows creative-work correlation but three cases have unstable thresholds, keep the creativity challenge and study more independent cases; the `3x10` hiring thesis is contradicted or narrowed.
- If the compact score is useful only combined with existing assessments, offer it as an incremental input with a new claim and decision study.
- If speech/video causes avoidable error, test typed or audio-only alternatives, even if that changes the original product form. Compare modes on the same construct rather than assuming equivalence.
- If future outcomes cannot be obtained across the full candidate pool, report the identification limit and avoid a broad "best engineers" claim.
- If fairness/access costs are unacceptable, pause use and redesign before further scaling.
